find: if (ev !== av) changes.push({ selector, field: `aria.${name}`, expected: ev, actual: av });
replace: if (ev?.trim() !== av?.trim()) changes.push({ selector, field: `aria.${name}`, expected: ev, actual: av });
killedBy: the screen baseline: role and aria attributes are compared exactly (issue #937) fails a renamed accessible name, and does not trim a value to make it match
why: Trims each attribute before comparing, so a value that changed only in whitespace reads as unchanged. The gate's job for these fields is to say what the DOM says: an id reference with a stray space no longer resolves, and an accessible name a screen reader reads aloud is the exact string, not a normalised one. Box geometry gets a tolerance because rasterisers differ; an attribute is the app's own string and gets none.
